texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TAIGA_ATACANTE_1: Snow, fir forest without end and a frozen river. Advance through the clearings; the ice will carry our men, but no horse can charge on it.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TAIGA_ATACANTE_2: Beyond the river stands their wooden fort behind its palisade. Take it.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TAIGA_DEFENSOR_1: The enemy comes out of the forest to the south. Meet them at the river.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_TAIGA_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the fort behind its palisade. Out here it is the only shelter for a hundred miles.
